question: Under what explicit support and slope conditions does the exact two-profile compatibility equation force a compact curvature-source change to vanish?
model: Exactly the projected-coordinate axisymmetric graph energy and balanced vertical dead-load conventions of nonlinear_source_design.json; no change of material labels, boundaries or load convention.

profile_prerequisite: Two actual stationary profiles under common c,f,kappa and distinct known positive tensions; algebraic coefficient examples alone must not be labeled such profiles.

sufficient uniqueness theorem on a declared source support, not global identifiability
origin limit and propagation from source-support boundary
isolated coefficient zeros, equal slopes, opposite slopes and intervals of equality
algebraic degeneracies distinct from jointly realizable equilibrium profiles
conditioning and joint-small-source order distinct from uniqueness
expected_outcomes: conditional sufficient uniqueness criterion with classified exceptions
stop_condition: One independently reviewed criterion or counterexample and explicit remaining prerequisite. No solver, empirical fit, parameter sweep, new source search, or practical precision/novelty claim. Any next stage requires a new decision after this one closes.
disclosure: Lead preliminary ODE reasoning preceded registration; this freezes the analytic contract and review, not a blind discovery claim.
